Versions 21–40 — repackaged inside the Version 00 framework

Each of the twenty recent concepts rebuilt inside the baseline’s page architecture, section order, hero placement and column structure. Same website, twenty design languages. Mapping runs 20.01 → 21 through 20.20 → 40.

Strongest five

36 · THE MEASURE26 · DARK STUDY34 · INDEX39 · TRANSLATION LADDER25 · THE FOLD
Strongest DNA section
36 · THE MEASURE — the dimension lines make the material bar read as evidence rather than decoration, and the leader lines give every term a reason to be where it is.
Strongest hero treatment
24 · OVERLAY — the only one that adds anything to the hero, and it adds analysis rather than effect: the four primary observations land on the machine as the gold reading settles.
Strongest expansion treatment
39 · TRANSLATION LADDER — the only version that answers "how far does this travel" instead of implying it. Observation → principle → territory → product, on one line.
Strongest overall candidate
36 · THE MEASURE — it is the most credible as an industrial-design practice, it keeps the baseline completely intact, and its apparatus would extend to any future section without being redesigned.
21 THE SPECIFICATION Recent Concept 20.01 → Version 21

Document authority — a page read top to bottom.

Idea preserved
Heavy full-width rules, the four primary observations in display type, and no photography inside the readings.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
The concept gave each reading a full-page band. Inside the baseline split the same authority comes from rule weight and a two-up observation grid.
22 THE PLATE Recent Concept 20.02 → Version 22

One enormous drawing carries a whole reading.

Idea preserved
The oversized analytical drawing, with the terms held small against it.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
A plate per section became a watermark behind the baseline’s form column, so the split and section order are untouched.
23 MARGIN NOTES Recent Concept 20.03 → Version 23

An annotated engineering document.

Idea preserved
Drawings set as right-aligned marginal notes, one entry to a line, hierarchy by position.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
The concept narrowed the whole page to a 940px measure. The margin now lives inside the left column, so the content width and two-column structure survive.
24 OVERLAY Recent Concept 20.04 → Version 24

The reading never leaves the object.

Idea preserved
Annotation in place, primaries landing before the supporting notes, cyan markers on the photograph.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
The concept added a second held image field. The tags now sit on the baseline hero itself, so no section is added.
25 THE FOLD Recent Concept 20.05 → Version 25 shortlist

The machine stays on screen while the reading passes it.

Idea preserved
The fold, and the source photograph held against the analysis.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
The photograph had its own tall column. The baseline’s right column is now sticky instead, so the grid and footprint are unchanged.
26 DARK STUDY Recent Concept 20.06 → Version 26 shortlist

The reading as a piece of engineering documentation.

Idea preserved
The near-black plate, full-strength cyan drawings, light type.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
Only the split goes dark. Hero, expansion and translations stay on the cream so the page rhythm is still the baseline’s.
27 THE LINE Recent Concept 20.07 → Version 27

The argument as stations on one line.

Idea preserved
The cyan spine and its filled markers at each stage of the sequence.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
The page was rebuilt around the line. It now runs down the inside edge of the baseline sections and marks the existing heads.
28 LARGE SYMBOL Recent Concept 20.08 → Version 28

The drawings are illustrations, not icons.

Idea preserved
Drawings at illustration scale, and photography kept out of the readings and the expansion section.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
One observation per screen became two-up inside the baseline’s own cells.
29 GRID BREAK Recent Concept 20.09 → Version 29

Nothing spans the number of columns you expect.

Idea preserved
Uneven spans and four aspect ratios inside one composition.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
The breaking now happens inside the baseline’s columns; the outer split and the content footprint are untouched.
30 CONTACT SHEET Recent Concept 20.10 → Version 30

Photography leads and the analysis follows it.

Idea preserved
The three-up sheet of source and process photography, with drawings reduced to citations.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
The sheet sits at the top of the baseline’s right column, where the material bar already was — nothing moves.
31 MANIFESTO Recent Concept 20.11 → Version 31

The argument made in sentences.

Idea preserved
The display sentence with the drawings set inside the lines at cap height.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
The whole page was prose. The manifesto now occupies the baseline’s statement block only; the readings stay in the grid.
32 DIPTYCH Recent Concept 20.12 → Version 32

Everything stated twice — evidence, then extraction.

Idea preserved
The photograph paired with the drawing taken from it, same size, same frame.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
Full-width paired panels became a pairing inside each observation cell.
33 FULL FRAME Recent Concept 20.13 → Version 33

The reading set over cinematic imagery.

Idea preserved
The widest crops, type over a guaranteed scrim, cyan picking out the examples.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
The frames are now the baseline’s own expansion cells, widened. No new section, and the readings above stay editorial.
34 INDEX Recent Concept 20.14 → Version 34 shortlist

One indexed run; row height is the only hierarchy.

Idea preserved
Numbers left, terms flush left, geometry flush right, primaries on a taller row.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
The index is now the baseline’s form column rather than the whole page.
35 THE STACK Recent Concept 20.15 → Version 35

Rhythm is the argument — depth states importance.

Idea preserved
The unequal band depths, with character given the most air.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
Depth is applied to the baseline’s own blocks. Only the spacing changes, never the order or the columns.
36 THE MEASURE Recent Concept 20.16 → Version 36 shortlist

The page behaves like the drawing office it came from.

Idea preserved
Dimension lines segment by segment across the material bar, leader lines from each term to its note, a datum rule.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
The apparatus is applied to the baseline’s existing blocks rather than the page being redrawn around it.
37 CENTRE LINE Recent Concept 20.17 → Version 37

The object has one centre line and so does the page.

Idea preserved
Symmetry, and the drawings mirrored either side of an axis.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
The whole page was centred on one axis. Each column now centres on its own, so the page keeps two columns.
38 DOCUMENT COVER Recent Concept 20.18 → Version 38

A design-language document, opened at its cover.

Idea preserved
The title block with its issue line, and numbered chapters.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
The cover was a section of its own. It now replaces the baseline’s statement, and the chapter numbers hang off the existing heads.
39 TRANSLATION LADDER Recent Concept 20.19 → Version 39 shortlist

How far the DNA actually travels.

Idea preserved
The four rungs — observation, principle, territory, product — read left to right with cyan arrows.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
The ladder is now the baseline’s expansion section; nothing else in the framework moves.
40 THE QUIET ONE Recent Concept 20.20 → Version 40

The least said.

Idea preserved
Radical restraint — minimum ink, maximum air.
Structural change made to return it to the baseline
The baseline’s styling is simplified, never its structure: rules removed, spacing doubled, everything left where it was.
Thumbnails captured from the live build at 1440 and 390. Version 00 and Versions 01–20 are unchanged and remain on the same slider.
